findings.description: The toothbrush's position and orientation do not match between the foreground view and the mirror reflection: in the foreground the toothbrush is held near the bottom of his chin, while in the mirror it is touching his upper lip/mustache area. Similarly, at 00:02 and 00:04, the toothbrush is at the side of his head/temple in the foreground, while in the mirror it is directly over the center of his eyebrow/forehead.

As the man raises the toothbrush to his head between 00:02 and 00:04, the object morphs from a white-handled toothbrush into a comb-like grooming tool with dark bristles/teeth, before reverting back into a white toothbrush at 00:05.
